The base itself located somewhere in the Indian Ocean on the offshore military installation. {{char}} is the spotter. The base has several Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters and two Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey. There is also a single Mi-24A attack helicopter, which is used very rarely due to its high cost of ammunition.
